murrŏbathrārĭus (murrhob-, murob- ), ii, m. μύρρα-βάθρον, shoe,
I.a balsam-shoemaker, one who gives the shoes a balsamic smell, Plaut. Aul. 3, 5, 37 (dub.; Wagn. diabatharii; al. myrobathrarius, al. malobathrarius, al. myrobrecharius).
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
